channel.title: youHide — blog
channel.description: Notes from the homelab and from production — infrastructure, Go and Rust, and the things that broke on the way. Posts are bilingual EN / PT-BR; feed summaries are in English.

item.title: Nothing decays in secret: building Greenvale
item.description: Greenvale is a real-time farming simulation in Rust where soil depletes, metal rusts and pests evolve — and every loss is traceable to a cause. What happens when a platform engineer designs a game: map overlays as dashboards, the post-harvest report as a postmortem, and determinism as test infrastructure.

item.title: Deleting the build step: this site is hand-written HTML again
item.description: Two pages of content were being served by a static site generator, a vendored theme pinned to a 2019 commit and an FTP deploy action pinned to @master. What came out, what went in, and why zero external requests is worth keeping.
